title: Accor rolls out AI travel assistant across its network
key_facts: The Accor hotel group is rolling out its dialogue-based (chat) travel assistant, ALL Concierge, globally.
The rollout follows a pilot phase lasting several months.
The application covers the entire customer journey.
It is designed to support internal processes as well as guest services.
Separately, Accor linked its existing partnership with Paris Saint-Germain to its Novotel Longevity programme; the global campaign 'The Long Game' launched in Paris this week.
